about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The CimcimKids story
about.p1: CimcimKids was founded to offer clothing kids can move freely in and parents can trust. Our mission is to bring together comfort, quality, and simple style.
about.p2: Our collections span from baby to school age. Every piece is carefully chosen with fabrics suited to everyday life and play.
about.p3: Comfort, durability, and customer satisfaction are our core values. Let’s complete little wardrobes together.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to your questions
faq.q1: How should I choose a size?
faq.a1: Each product page includes age/size guidance. If unsure, size up or contact us.
faq.a2: Domestic orders are delivered within 2–5 business days. Shipping is free on orders of 1,500 TL and above; below that the shipping fee is 119 TL. Track your order on our tracking page.
faq.q3: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a3: We accept credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Troy) via iyzico 3D Secure, and bank transfer (wire/EFT).
faq.q4: How should I wash the products?
faq.a4: Most of our products are suitable for a gentle 30°C wash. Please follow the care label on each item.
faq.a5: We do not currently offer gift wrapping. You can buy a gift card instead.

privacy.title: Privacy & Security Policy
privacy.intro: At CimcimKids, we take the security of your personal data seriously.
privacy.s1: Collected data is used only for order processing, customer service, and legal obligations. Details are set out in the KVKK Privacy Notice.
privacy.s2: Card payments are processed by iyzico with 3D Secure; we do not store card numbers. Bank transfer details are shown after checkout. Our website and database run on Hetzner infrastructure in Germany / the EU (and, where needed, cloud database providers in the EU/EEA), so your data may be processed abroad for hosting purposes.
privacy.s3: Cookies and similar technologies are used to improve the site experience; you can control them in browser settings.

distanceSales.title: Distance Sales Agreement
distanceSales.s1: This agreement is governed by applicable consumer protection laws between CimcimKids and the consumer.
distanceSales.s2: Order confirmation is sent by email. Right of withdrawal can be exercised within 14 days.
distanceSales.s3: Product prices include VAT. Payment can be made by credit/debit card (iyzico) or bank transfer. Shipping is free on orders of 1,500 TL and above; below that the shipping fee is 119 TL.

kvkk.title: Personal Data Protection Notice (KVKK)
kvkk.intro: Under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK"), we inform you about how CimcimKids processes your personal data.
kvkk.s1: Data controller: CimcimKids. Address: Antalya, Turkey. Contact: info@cimcimkids.com — Phone: +90 533 700 73 18
kvkk.s2: Identity data (name, surname), contact data (email, phone, address), order and transaction data (products, amount, order number), customer transaction history; and, if you opt in, newsletter subscription data.
kvkk.s3: Receiving and delivering orders, managing payment processes (iyzico card payments and bank transfer), customer service and communication, securely operating site infrastructure, fulfilling legal obligations, performance of the distance sales agreement; and, with explicit consent, marketing / newsletter communication.
kvkk.s4title: 4. Transfer of Personal Data and Cross-Border Transfer
kvkk.s4: Your personal data may be transferred to authorized public institutions when legally required, to shipping companies for delivery, and to technical infrastructure providers we use. Our website and database are hosted on servers of Hetzner Online GmbH in Germany / the European Union (and, where needed, cloud database providers in the EU/EEA). Due to this hosting, your personal data is transferred abroad under KVKK Art. 9. Purpose of the transfer: secure website hosting and storage/processing of order and customer data. Cross-border transfers are carried out with the data subject’s information and explicit consent given at checkout and, to the extent necessary for contract performance, under other applicable KVKK grounds.
kvkk.s5: Your data is collected electronically via the website order form, contact form, newsletter signup, and automated log / security records. Legal bases: KVKK Art. 5/2-c (establishment or performance of a contract), Art. 5/2-ç (legal obligation), Art. 5/2-f (legitimate interest); and for cross-border transfer and marketing communications, explicit consent under KVKK Art. 5/1 and Art. 9.
kvkk.s6: Your personal data is retained for the period required by the processing purpose and applicable legal retention periods (10 years for commercial records), then deleted, destroyed, or anonymized.
kvkk.s7: Under KVKK Art. 11, you have the right to learn whether your data is processed, request information, learn the purpose and whether it is used accordingly, know third parties in Turkey or abroad to whom data is transferred, request correction, request deletion or destruction, and withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.
kvkk.s8: To exercise your rights, send a written request to info@cimcimkids.com. Your requests will be answered free of charge within 30 days at the latest.
